description: This file defines a React component for the navigation bar ('Navbar') in the front-end of a library management system. It includes a subcomponent 'BrandIcon' that displays a book emoji as a branding icon. The Navbar component renders a top navigation bar with accessible labels and branding information.

methods.name: BrandIcon()
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a div containing a book emoji as a branding icon.

methods.name: Navbar()
methods.description: A React functional component that renders the top navigation bar with branding and accessibility attributes.
